Callout.Name: Lost Child - Trail Head
Callout.Message: Child missing from a trail head car park.
Callout.Advisory: Family on scene, child gone ten minutes.

Script.Line: He was at the map board two minutes ago and then he was not.
He has a red coat on. That is the only thing I can tell you.
He will have gone down the path. He always goes down the path.

Lines.Approach: Ten minutes gone and the family are already heading four different ways. That is how this gets worse.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
